status: prospective training and evaluation amendment; efficacy not launched
reason: The original frozen method protocol referred to fixed project split roles and identical training schedules but did not enumerate the sequence roles, optimizer schedule, or validation/checkpoint-selection implementation. This amendment makes those requirements executable before training.
scope: PolypGen development only. All sequences have informed prior experiments, including the listed test sequences. Results are exploratory and not independent confirmation.

data.leakage_rule: Sequence roles are disjoint. Do not use test Dice, masks, or failure cases to tune any setting or select an epoch. Test set has been examined in earlier methods and is exploratory.

conditions.native: Pinned pretrained SAM2.1 Hiera-Tiny, no added affinity module.
conditions.token_affinity: Four XMem-style dense per-token affinity adapters, trained with granularity=token.
conditions.frame_broadcast_control: Same adapter topology, initialization, parameter count and training schedule, with granularity=frame; each query's complete affinity scores are averaged over spatial tokens within each memory frame and broadcast to that frame's tokens.

training.precision: FP32 except SAM2's stored memory features remain in native bfloat16 storage format.
training.clip_plan: Use SAM2 author's pinned contiguous clip sampler. Construct one deterministic clip plan from the frozen seed and apply the identical sequence, frame, and order plan to both learned arms. Each clip starts with a visible-object ground-truth prompt and has seven post-prompt frames.
training.loss: Reuse SAM2/Run174 present-mask BCE-Dice-style loss on pre-suppression decoder logits plus the existing object-presence loss. Ground truth is loss-only after the prompt; all later memory writes are generated by the current arm's own predictions.
training.frozen: All pretrained SAM2 weights, image encoder, memory encoder and mask decoder are frozen in eval mode. Only adapter projections and per-layer affinity strengths train.
training.initialization: Use identical deterministic adapter initialization for token and frame-broadcast arms; verify their initial state hashes match.
training.checkpointing: Save adapter, optimizer, Python/NumPy/PyTorch RNG, epoch/clip cursor, validation state, completed clip receipts, data-plan hash and run setup hash atomically. Resume must reproduce the next real-frame update exactly before efficacy training is permitted.
training.no_sweeps: One seed and this fixed schedule for the first exploratory run. No hyperparameter, seed, architecture or threshold sweep.

validation_and_selection.selection: Choose highest validation mean; exact ties select earliest epoch.
validation_and_selection.test_access: Do not generate any test predictions until training and checkpoint selection for both learned arms are complete.

primary_and_secondary_evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence present-frame Dice on seq16-seq23; paired contrasts token-affinity minus native and token-affinity minus frame-broadcast control.
primary_and_secondary_evaluation.inference: Full chronological propagation after one first-frame ground-truth prompt; each arm uses its own predicted-mask memory writes. No good/bad frame selection, hard gating or token pruning.

stopping_rule.continue_only_if: Token-affinity improves equal-sequence test Dice by at least 0.01 over both native SAM2 and frame-broadcast control, each paired sequence-bootstrap 95% interval has a lower bound above zero, the pooled GT-empty false-alarm rate is no more than 0.02 higher than either control, and the total number of undetected return events is no higher than either control.
stopping_rule.false_alarm_denominator: All ground-truth-empty post-prompt frames pooled over the same eight test sequences for each arm; compare absolute rates.
stopping_rule.missed_return_rule: Report the frozen propagation re-detection metrics; any increase in missed returning-object events is a failure of the safety condition.
stopping_rule.failure: If any condition fails, record negative or inconclusive result and stop this candidate. Do not tune against these sequences.
stopping_rule.interpretation_limit: PolypGen cannot provide independent confirmation here. No publishability or generalization claim follows without a newly acquired, untouched multi-object VOS dataset and a separately passing persistent-ID gate.

preconditions_before_training: Complete adapter/optimizer/RNG save-resume equivalence on the actual autoregressive training path.

Pass real-frame seq2/seq3 training gate with own-prediction memory writes, all four attention layers, exact native zero-strength parity, unchanged original SAM2 parameters, unchanged spatial/pointer/key-position geometry, and finite nonzero adapter-only gradients.
Pass the multi-object persistent-ID isolation gate for the installed attention adapter.
Run source/data/protocol integrity tests and freeze the runner source snapshot and setup receipt.
Confirm the completed within-frame utility diagnostic and Run174 results are included in the pre-run audit.

provenance: setup.json hashes the frozen method and efficacy protocols, pinned checkpoint, manifest, clean SAM2 revision, software versions, and exact probe inputs.
source_snapshot.zip is hashed in setup.json; every archived source hash matches the setup source inventory.
completion.json hashes setup.json, source_snapshot.zip, and results.json.
gate_completion_schema.authorization: The training runner must verify every required check is true and all provenance hashes before training. Partial or legacy receipts never authorize efficacy.

storage: Write receipts, source snapshots, logs, checkpoints, predictions, metrics, and summaries under mounted Drive outputs/experiment/xmem_token_affinity_polypgen_v1. A mounted path alone does not prove cloud synchronization.

provenance.status_at_freeze: The seq2/seq3 real-checkpoint integration probe is only a partial engineering pass. It did not test autoregressive training or exact save/resume and is not a training authorization.
